schedule_contract: High-level ac.schedule requires an explicit all-ones sentinel; DependencyOp verifies the typed v2 provider, exact <=16-bit key/waits-for types, and sentinel in Frozen ACIR; QueueGraph preserves and defensively rechecks the provider, accepts direct-root policy yields, retains bounded completion readiness after producer output, rejects key reuse before reset, and clears completion history on reset.
pto_specialization: ac.schedule.v2 uses a prevalidated finite physical-tag/generation scoreboard, ordered shadow rename, multiple exact-generation dependencies, four bounded issue queues, parent-owned Queue endpoints, fail-closed invalid-engine dispatch, and atomic Work/Arbitrate/Xfer.
boundedness: A 64-iteration allocate/overwrite/issue/complete/recycle test returns outstanding producer and live flow counts to zero while reusing the lowest tags with increasing generations.
pyc_boundary: Multi-port schedule-v2 PYC/Verilog lowering fails explicitly and remains assigned to issue #21.
release_scope: Focused gfsim schedule semantics and Queue ABI; complete release lanes remain release-workflow authority.
